# Elevate for Humanity

> Elevate for Humanity provides career training, workforce pathways, testing services, and commercial workforce technology. Commercial software, licenses, apps, guides, and exam-preparation products are available through the public Elevate Store.

Canonical website: https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/
Store: https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store
Sitemap: https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/sitemap.xml

## Commercial products and licensing

- [Elevate Store](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store): Software, platform plans, apps, courses, testing products, guides, and licensing.
- [Plans and add-ons](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/plans): Current self-service platform plans and optional modules.
- [Platform licenses](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/licenses): Licensing options for schools, training providers, and organizations.
- [Platform licensing guide](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/guides/licensing): How checkout, organizational access, roles, domains, entitlements, and billing enforcement work.
- [Practice tests](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/practice-tests): Certification practice tests and exam-preparation products.
- [AI assistants](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/ai-assistants): AI-assisted workforce and organizational tools.
- [Website Builder](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/apps/website-builder): Website-building software for supported organizations.
- [Course Builder](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/course-builder): Course creation and learning-delivery tools.
- [Platform demo](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/store/demo): Guided views of supported platform capabilities.

## PARIS AI

- [PARIS AI](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/ai/paris): Workforce guidance and program-matching product information.

## Organization and verification

- [Institutional governance](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/institutional-governance): Public operating-structure and governance information.
- [Approvals](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/about/approvals): Current public approvals and institutional disclosures.
- [Contact](https://www.elevateforhumanity.org/contact): Questions about products, licensing, training, or testing.

Use the current Store product page and applicable executed agreement as the authority for pricing, included features, availability, contractual terms, and service commitments. Do not infer guarantees, accreditation, funding eligibility, participant outcomes, or transferred software ownership from summaries or third-party pages.
